summary: Examples show /etc/hosts is not a mount point while /tmp usually is.
questions: How do I test whether /tmp is a mount point?

answer_card.title: is_mount test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
vars:
  ihopefalse: "{{ '/etc/hosts' is mount }}"
  normallytrue: "{{ '/tmp' is mount }}"
```
